create_ttyrecs_db: create a ttyrecs database using db.create to store NetHack game recordings
test_db_connection: test the database connection by opening a read-only connection with db.db()
test_db_ls: test listing all ttyrec entries in the database using db.ls and verify row count
test_db_get_row: test retrieving specific ttyrec rows by row ID using db.get_row to inspect path and size
test_db_get_games: test querying games per user from a dataset using db.get_games to list game IDs and ranges
